items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.summary: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.

items.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
items.summary: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground!"

items.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
items.summary: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

items.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
items.summary: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

items.title: Legal challenge to Australia's social media ban to start in High Court
items.summary: A rights group will argue the world-leading policy robs under-16s of their right to free communication.

items.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
items.summary: The case, part of the "Farmgate" scandal, has left President Cyril Ramaphosa mired in an impeachment saga.
